controls.summary: All CI/CD and release workflows pin every GitHub Action to immutable 40-character commit SHAs with minimal least-privilege token permissions and persist-credentials: false.

Tag-triggered releases generate SHA-256 checksums, attach CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM, sign SLSA v1 build provenance attestations, and CI enforces bit-for-bit reproducible WASM double-builds (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH + --remap-path-prefix) plus artifact forensics.
Comprehensive architecture, profile usage, formal verification, reproducibility, and citation metadata published in machine-readable and human-readable forms.
Public contribution policy enforcing IETF RFC 8179 IPR disclosure, Apache-2.0 inbound=outbound licensing, triple-engine parity, and IETF RFC 7154 + Contributor Covenant 2.1 conduct standards.
Canonical SPDX Apache-2.0 LICENSE and LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt with 100% FSFE REUSE 3.3 SPDX coverage enforced continuously in CI.

Automated CI gates enforce Rust clippy (-D warnings), #![forbid(unsafe_code)], cross-manifest version parity, anti-obfuscation guards, Appendix D + strict conformance, 64-variant CBOR framing-space parity, Z3 SMT formal invariants, 50k triple differential, 100k mutation fuzz, and 120k WASM leak verification.

Documented threat model defining trust boundaries, explicit non-goals, bounded O(1)-stack/O(1)-UTF-8/DAG DoS budgets, LEB128/CBOR/JSON parity defenses, strict consensus ceilings, zero-dependency CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM, and browser WASM zero-egress isolation (connect-src 'none', 0 imports).

RFC 9116 aligned private vulnerability reporting (GitHub Security Advisories + OpenPGP email), 48h acknowledgement SLA, 14d triage target, Safe Harbor, OpenVEX v0.2.0 exploitability baseline, weekly Dependabot monitoring, and continuous OpenSSF Scorecard SARIF reporting.
